description: Sparse matrix-vector multiplication y = A*x in JDS (Jagged Diagonal Storage) layout. The matrix is sorted by row length and stored column-major (padded/transposed) so one thread walks its JDS row at stride-1 offsets; per-warp-group column counts and column base offsets live in constant memory. Faithful port of the Parboil cuda kernel spmv_jds (x fetched via __ldg in place of the original texture); emits per-iteration kernel times. Direct-binary block-size and CLI seed controls are not swept; each kernel record identifies the resolved seed, requested block size, launch policy, and effective block/grid sizes.

scaling_param.name: num_rows
scaling_param.description: Number of matrix rows (JDS tables cap this near 160000)

non_scaling_params.name: avg_nnz_per_row
non_scaling_params.description: Average non-zeros per row (JDS column depth must stay < 5000)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
